title: A privacy-aware method for COVID-19 detection in chest CT images using lightweight deep conventional neural network and blockchain.
summary: Transfer-learned CNNs trained across five hospital datasets improved average COVID-19 CT classification metrics against tested baselines; this is dataset performance, not demonstrated clinical benefit.
